title: The Subjective view of the matter
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：subjective　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 subjective 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the gardener wrote of ① a subjective view of the matter in the notebook, and everybody in the garden said at once that it was ② so subjective that nobody in the garden would go near it. Three springs on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the gardener, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the subjective ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the subjective view of the matter that anybody there had ever seen, or so the notebook for April 1966 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too subjective to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the apprentice who had come to help; the subjective ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the trowel at the far bed, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a subjective feeling of the judge, and said that no apprentice in his right mind would call it ⑥ as subjective as the feeling of the judge they had once had in the old garden. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was subjective or not, and he said so.

By 1979 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the notebook. What the line asked for was ⑦ something subjective, and nothing besides. The apprentice from the next garden called the whole plan ⑧ quite subjective; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the notebook kept the names of the subjective ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1982, at once, she wrote of another subjective view of the matter in the same notebook, and the work, which took two springs, seemed ⑨ no less subjective than anybody had expected. ⑩ The subjective feeling of the judge that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1984, was the one she could never quite name; the subjective ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 主观（前置定语 a subjective view of the matter：1972 年园丁在园艺笔记里记下的那件主观的看法）
B. adj. 主观／个人（两处加强说法：so subjective that … 与 no less subjective than …）
C. adj. 主观／个人（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 主观（表语 too subjective to do：母亲觉得它太主观，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 个人（前置定语 a subjective feeling of the judge：叔叔把整件事称作一桩个人的感受）
F. adj. 个人（同级比较 as subjective as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩评判者的个人感受相比）
G. adj. 个人（后置定语 something subjective：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 个人（受程度副词修饰 quite subjective：那位学徒的评价）

items.q: a subjective view of the matter
the subjective view of the matter that
a subjective feeling of the judge
The subjective feeling of the judge that

answers.why: subjective 意为“主观”，1972 年园丁在园艺笔记里记下的是“一件主观的看法”，此处作前置定语 a subjective view of the matter。
subjective 意为“主观”，此处用 so subjective that 结构，说它主观到园子里没人敢靠近。
subjective 意为“主观”，园艺笔记上 四月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的主观对事情的主观看法，等于最高级的说法。
subjective 意为“主观”，母亲认为这件东西“太主观了，谁也用不上”，too subjective to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
subjective 意为“个人”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩个人的感受”，此处作前置定语 a subjective feeling of the judge。
subjective 意为“个人”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩评判者的个人感受一样个人”，同级比较用 as subjective as。
subjective 意为“个人”，园艺笔记上那半行字要的是“个人的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something subjective。
subjective 意为“个人”，邻园子来的那位学徒认为这套计划“相当个人”，quite 修饰原级 subjective。
subjective 意为“个人”，no less subjective than 表示“其个人不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之个人不亚于任何人的预料。
subjective 意为“个人”，母亲 1984 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的个人感受”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1972 年，园丁在园艺笔记里记下了一件主观的看法。（a subjective view of the matter）
它主观到园子里没有一个人敢靠近。（so subjective that …）
母亲觉得它太主观，谁也用不上。（too subjective to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩个人的感受。（a subjective feeling of the judge）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩评判者的个人感受一样个人。（as subjective as …）
到了 1979 年，园艺笔记上只剩半行字：要的是一件个人的东西。（something subjective）
answers: In 1972 the gardener wrote of a subjective view of the matter in the notebook.
It was so subjective that nobody in the garden would go near it.
My mother thought it too subjective to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a subjective feeling of the judge.
He said nobody would call it as subjective as the feeling of the judge they had once had.
By 1979 the notebook asked for nothing but something subjective.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 subjective 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1972 the gardener wrote of a subjective view of the matter in the notebook, and nobody forgot it.
It was the subjective view of the matter that anybody there had ever seen, or so the notebook says.
My mother thought it too subjective to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a subjective feeling of the judge, and nobody argued with him.
The apprentice from the next garden called the plan quite subjective, and everybody laughed.
The subjective ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
